Quote card: bg-white rounded-xl p-8 shadow text-center. Quote icon: text-4xl text-blue-200 mb-4. Text: text-lg text-gray-700 italic mb-6. variants.simple: Create testimonial slider with quotes and avatars.
variants.detailed: Create testimonials section. Container: py-16 bg-gray-50. Header: text-center mb-12, title text-3xl font-bold. Carousel: max-w-3xl mx-auto relative. Quote card: bg-white rounded-xl p-8 shadow text-center. Quote icon: text-4xl text-blue-200 mb-4. Text: text-lg text-gray-700 italic mb-6. variants.advanced: Create versatile testimonial component. Layout options: carousel (one at a time), grid (show multiple), masonry (varied heights), single featured. Carousel: auto-play with pause on hover, swipe on mobile, prev/next buttons (hide at ends or loop), dot indicators or thumbnail navigation. Quote card: large quote mark decoration, testimonial text, author photo, author name, author title/company, company logo (optional), rating stars (optional). Video testimonials: play button overlay, modal player, thumbnail. Multiple display: show 1/2/3 at a time based on viewport. Transition effects: fade, slide, or flip between testimonials. Filter by: category, industry, use case tabs above carousel. Featured: highlight one "featured" testimonial differently. Quote length: truncate long quotes with "Read more", expand in modal. Company logos: row of client logos below testimonials. CTA: "See all testimonials" or "Submit your story" link. Schema markup: Review structured data. Integration: pull from Google Reviews, Trustpilot, G2 APIs. Randomize: optionally randomize order. Accessibility: pause auto-play control, keyboard navigation, proper carousel ARIA. Loading: skeleton or placeholder during async load.
